payload.title: Colours are converted relative colorimetric with black point compensation, and the stored file carries no profile
payload.context: Images (#25): an intent and a tagging policy had to be chosen for uploads with an embedded profile.
payload.rationale: In-gamut colours stay exact and CMYK blacks stay black, as measured. Untagged means sRGB, the file stays pixels only, and the same picture stays the same bytes for deduplication. A broken profile falls back to treating the pixels as sRGB.
payload.consequences: Out-of-gamut colours are clipped. How Facebook and LinkedIn treat an untagged file is not verified. Firefox on a wide-gamut screen may show the preview oversaturated.
